data.name: Jagabandhu
data.gender_notes: Jagabandhu is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jaga: to move, protect. Bandhu: friend, ally. God's Blessing, protector, friend, ally. The name Jagabandhu carries the meaning “God's Blessing” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jagabandhu usually hope their child will grow to embody god's blessing and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name blessed by God, symbolizing protection and companionship.
data.etymology: Jagabandhu belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's Blessing.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jagabandhu total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

historical_references.reference: Jagabandhu Mohapatra was a prominent leader of the 1857 Indian Rebellion in the eastern provinces of British India.
historical_references.context: The Indian Rebellion, also known as the Sepoy Mutiny, was a major uprising against the British East India Company rule in India. Jagabandhu led the rebellion in the region of Odisha.

historical_references.reference: Jagabandhu Chhatrapati Shahu is a legendary Maratha king who ruled the princely state of Kolhapur from 1774 to 1812.
historical_references.context: Jagabandhu Shahu was a brave and just ruler who expanded the territories of his state, maintained peace and order, and promoted Hindu and Maratha culture. He is revered as a hero in the Maratha community.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name 'Jagabandhu' is derived from the Hindu mythology and is associated with the legendary figure Jagannath, who is the presiding deity of the Jagannath Temple in Puri, Odisha. The name 'Jagabandhu' has gained modern usage in various contexts. It is seen in academic discussions on east Indian folklore, particularly in relation to the cult of Jagannath and the associated festivals and rituals. In Indian cinema, the name 'Jagabandhu' has been used in films such as 'Jagabandhu Chhatrapati' (1981) and 'Jagabandhu Baro Sera' (2019), which are based on the life and legends of the historical figure Jagabandhu Bidarbharan, who led a rebellion against the British colonial rule in the late 18th century. Lastly, the name 'Jagabandhu' is also a popular topic on Reddit, where it is discussed in various subreddits dedicated to Indian mythology, history, and popular culture.
